title: Imminent names BAE Systems as an inheritor of UFO technology

tellings.quote: >> Lou's book revealed a ton. And it also if you read imminent his book, he talks about BAE Systems as one of the companies that inherited, you know, UFO technology.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Imminent, a book by Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on UFO questions. Michels says the book names BAE Systems, a large defence company, as one of the firms that inherited UFO technology. If true, it would mean private defence contractors hold recovered non-human technology.
